description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of data entries across different task categories, divided into seven distinct slices. Arranged counter-clockwise starting from the top vertical axis, the segments generally appear in descending order of size, with the exception of the final combined category. The largest slice, colored light red, represents "Math" at 29.3%. Continuing counter-clockwise, this is followed by a light blue slice for "Coding" (24.3%), a bright green slice for "Information Seeking" (22.2%), a light orange slice for "Reasoning" (10.4%), a light purple slice for "Planning" (2.3%), and a pink slice for "Creative Writing" (2.2%). Finally, a pale green slice located at the top right, labeled "Others (combined)," accounts for the remaining 9.3%. A legend positioned in the top-left corner under the heading "Categories" provides a color key alongside the category names and their absolute numerical counts in parentheses. Furthermore, category names and their corresponding percentages are positioned as text labels directly outside each respective slice. There are no percentage labels inside the slices, and none of the segments are visually emphasized, offset, or exploded.
